about.html: APPLY

Keepers of Coffee, known around Rice as KOCs, are the baristas who keep Coffeehouse running. The key to why KOCs are so special? All employees are regular Rice students! We balance our academic schedules with our passion for making lots and lots of coffee, exactly how you want it. We take a lot of pride in making Coffeehouse a place where we, and all of Rice, can feel at home. It’s this dedication–and a healthy dose of shenanigans–that make Chaus, Chaus. Meet our managers for 2024-2025 here.

about.html: Rice Coffeehouse is a student run coffeehouse on Rice University's campus. We are managed and staffed by students with guidance from our two wonderful advisors Caitlin and Cristy. As a Student Run Business, Coffeehouse managers work together to make sure that the rent is paid, the products are served, the catering orders are filled, health code is followed, and a good time is had by all that come to Coffeehouse.

about.html: Coffeehouse loves sustainability. Our sustainability efforts include our Bring Your Own Mug Discount, Coffeehouse Sustainability Week, Fair Trade/Direct Trade Coffee from Katz, in-house mugs, recycling, 100% Recycled Content Napkins, and a linen. about.html: Espresso Yourself is a collective within Coffeehouse dedicated to encouraging student creativity and sharing art with our community. Pre-COVID, this meant hanging student art around the café space and hosting in-house concerts and open mics. This year, we debuted our Artist Spotlight series. We select student artists, showcase their portfolios, host artist talks where they discuss their work and process, and sell merch featuring their work! Applications are currently closed, but follow us on Instagram for updates.

Since 2003, Katz has served some of Houston’s most highly-acclaimed and discriminating chefs and restaurant & coffeehouse owners. They specialize in small-batch, custom roasting while providing the finest coffee from our farmers around the globe. Their goal is to achieve perfection in every cup.  This commitment starts with sourcing the highest quality “green” beans and the close and careful attention we take in the roasting process. Katz is our exclusive provider of all coffee

SUSTAINABILITY

Did you know? You can bring your own mug to Coffeehouse to avoid wasting a disposable cup, helping us generate less waste. If you’re just getting drip coffee, you even get a discount: coffee is just 95 cents. We’ll even help you rinse out your mug once you’re finished. Just ask the barista behind the counter.

sustainability.html: Own-Mug Discount + 95-cent Drip

Every year, we partner with Rice Environmental Society to throw a Coffeehouse Sustainability Week. During this week, we discounted own-mug purchases by fifty cents and sold Coffeehouse-branded thermoses at a major discount. Less paper cups and more coffee? A win for everyone.

sustainability.html: Recycling

Instead of throwing away our cleaning materials at the end of the day, Coffeehouse now uses a linen service that washes our towels, rags, and mops for re-use. This enables us to save over 4,000 single-use rags from disposal each year!

sustainability.html: Coffeehouse is run by students for students and the Houston community. Though we may be currently closed, we are committed to combating the systems of oppression upon which this country was founded. We will work to uplift Black and other marginalized voices. As the General Manager of Coffeehouse, I want to make it clear that Coffeehouse stands in solidarity with the Black community against racial injustices.
sustainability.text: Coffeehouse is run by students for students and the Houston community. Though we may be currently closed, we are committed to combating the systems of oppression upon which this country was founded. We will work to uplift Black and other marginalized voices. As the General Manager of Coffeehouse, I want to make it clear that Coffeehouse stands in solidarity with the Black community against racial injustices.

sustainability.html: In recent years, Coffeehouse has defined its mission statement as focusing on environmental sustainability. However, we are first a community driven by people. There will be no sustainable future if communities continue to experience systematic oppression. Inequality and oppression constantly affect the lives of marginalized people, so it is imperative that our support lasts beyond this news cycle.
sustainability.text: In recent years, Coffeehouse has defined its mission statement as focusing on environmental sustainability. However, we are first a community driven by people. There will be no sustainable future if communities continue to experience systematic oppression. Inequality and oppression constantly affect the lives of marginalized people, so it is imperative that our support lasts beyond this news cycle.

sustainability.html: As a long term financial commitment by Coffeehouse, I am announcing the Bean Fund, an annual $1000 dedicated towards causes of social justice as it relates to environmental sustainability. The fund is meant to provide flexibility and ensure our approach towards environmental sustainability is intersectional. We will first be donating 750 dollars split across three organizations: Black Lives Matter Houston, Texas Organizing Project, and BLMHTX; a fourth donation will be decided by our team at a later date, totaling $1000.
